I have farmed in Tabora for many years without school learning, so I trust what I know from experience. For this rented plot of beans, I will use manure that I have gathered rather than buy costly chemical fertilizer, and I will plant the local seeds I kept from last harvest. My family and I will manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves with our hand hoes, as the plot is small enough that we do not need outside workers.
